_doc: Careers that emerge as the tribe develops (careers.gd, sim.careers). A small band does everything; as the tribe grows and learns, some families come to live by one trade. Each grown-up's `calling` (u.calling: career id -> points) grows by `from` (tag -> points per second) while their hands are at work: tags are doing:<what the hands do> (u.doing: chop, butcher, quarry, pick, build, fight, ritual, experiment, craft, paint, spar...), job:<job type> (tend, explore, trade_trip, envoy...) and kind:<the node they gather from> (deer, carcass, bush, fish, mushroom, flint...). Every `decay_every` days all callings are multiplied by `decay`. A career is open while its `open` condition holds (story.holds: tech, invention, built, pop, era...). Someone takes up an open career when its calling reaches `take`, leads their next calling by `lead` times, their `skill` is at least `min_lv`, the career has fewer than `max` holders and the tribe has a free specialist place: `places` = floor(grown-ups x share), `share` by era, none below `min_pop` grown-ups. A career lapses when its calling falls below `keep` (they stopped doing it). Holders work `work_mult` times as fast while doing their trade (any of its tags), fight `atk_mult` times as hard and walk `speed_mult` times as fast while at their trade. When idle by day near home (after `idle_secs`), or when the Steward hands out work and the stores hold `steward_food_per_head` food each, they go to their trade (`work`: {gather: resource, kinds: [node kinds]} | {ritual: true} | {art: true} | {build: true} | {work_at: a worked structure type: the nearest with a free place}; none = no work of its own). `max`: at most this many holders, a number or {base, per_pop} (grows with the tribe). `preferred`: the career whose holders are sent first for a duty (tend: the herd; warchief: the War Chief's fighters). Texts: name (the career, a person is 'a <name>'), plural, desc (sheet), open_log (the tribe can first spare hands for it; var: plural; not written for trades open from the first day), log/remember/popup (taking it up; vars: who, name), lapse_log, set_log (named by the chieftain or a game master), feat_title (the tribe's first of each career: an achievement).

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.desc: Lives by the hunt: goes after game when nothing else is asked

gatherer.name: Gatherer
gatherer.desc: Knows every berry patch and root ground

farmer.name: Farmer
farmer.desc: Works the fields from sowing to harvest

fisher.name: Fisher
fisher.desc: Spends the days at the water with hook and line

woodcutter.name: Woodcutter
woodcutter.desc: Fells the trees the tribe burns and builds with

stonecutter.name: Stonecutter
stonecutter.desc: Breaks stone from the boulders and knaps flint

builder.name: Builder
builder.desc: Raises the tribe's buildings and keeps them standing

shaman.name: Shaman
shaman.desc: Keeps the rites and the tribe's lore

artisan.name: Artisan
artisan.desc: Carves, paints and makes the goods the tribe trades and treasures

herder.name: Herder
herder.desc: Tends the pack oxen: sent first when the herd needs care

warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.desc: Trains for battle: hits harder and is the War Chief's first call

scout.name: Scout
scout.desc: Knows the land beyond the firelight: travels it faster

open_log: The tribe can now spare hands for a trade of their own: %s.
remember: took up a trade of their own (%s) on Day %d
lapse_log: %s no longer lives by their trade (%s).
set_log: %s is given a trade by the chieftain: %s.
